evaluator.id: fresh general subagent, blinded to condition

items.evidence: Baseline before any code change (warmup 5/runs 15, 5 reps at 128x128, 3 at 256x256), per-stage medians/min/max, explicit variance policy (non-overlapping spreads meaningful, overlapping inconclusive).
Measurement identifies transform as hotspot (94-98%: 26.2/27.0ms at 128x128); encode measured ~0.7-2.1ms, not assumed slow.
Encode join proposal applied and re-measured; distributions overlap completely (0.57-0.71 vs 0.50-0.76ms), rejected on evidence; fix targets transform.
Byte-identical via sha256 fixed vs baseline (git show HEAD) at 64x64/128x128/256x256/7x3, matching byte counts and harness bytes.
Hoists whole-image averaging out of per-output-pixel loops in transform.js only — minimal change at owning stage.
Same protocol/input/reps after fix with per-stage medians and min-max; before/after spreads non-overlapping for transform/total.
Distinguishes looks-slow from is-slow: encode linear (0.09→2.15ms while bytes grow 16x, V8 ropes), transform O(outW×outH×inW×inH) grounded in measured scaling.
Environment factors reported (shared laptop, background load, CPU scaling, JIT/GC) with compensation; overlapping encode measurements treated as inconclusive.

deterministic_checks.name: oracle: golden checksum identical + transform/total medians < 1/4 of pristine
